The indexed searches failed, so I’m checking the University of Leicester journal site directly for the paper and its stated volume.
```python
direct_search = await web_fetch("https://physics.le.ac.uk/journals/index.php/pst/search/search?query=Hiccup", max_chars=20000)
print(direct_search)
```
I’m also querying the journal site’s publication search by the paper’s distinctive title fragment.
```python
direct_search_title = await web_fetch("https://physics.le.ac.uk/journals/index.php/pst/search/search?query=dragon", max_chars=20000)
print(direct_search_title)
```
The site search endpoint did not expose the result through the text fetcher; I’m checking the University of Leicester domain for a PDF or article record using its likely archive paths.
```python
domain_search = await web_search("physics.le.ac.uk journals pst Hiccup fish")
print(domain_search)
```
I couldn’t verify the paper’s fish-bag volume from the available sources.
